name: V3 NPC and Federation phases
description: Runtime contract checks for the immutable MSL, daily sweep and durable NPC state.

tests.name: Phase 1: MSL sweep state exists

data.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name = 'fedspace_sweep_runs';

tests.name: Phase 1: BigBang MSL remains populated

data.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM msl_sectors;

tests.name: Phase 2: NPC action log exists

data.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name = 'npc_action_log';

tests.name: Fixture: Ensure Ferengi faction for the NPC tick

data.sql: INSERT INTO corporations(name,owner_id,tag) SELECT 'Ferengi Alliance',player_id,'FENG' FROM players WHERE name='System' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM corporations WHERE tag='FENG');

tests.name: Fixture: Ensure Ferengi homeworld for the NPC tick

data.sql: INSERT INTO planets(planet_id,num,sector_id,name,owner_id,owner_type,class,type,created_by) SELECT 2,2,2,'Ferengi Homeworld',corporation_id,'corp','M',(SELECT planettypes_id FROM planettypes WHERE code='M'),owner_id FROM corporations WHERE tag='FENG' ON CONFLICT(planet_id) DO UPDATE SET owner_id=EXCLUDED.owner_id,owner_type='corp',sector_id=2;

tests.name: Enable deterministic scheduler for NPC persistence acceptance

data.sql: INSERT INTO config(key,value,type) VALUES('test.deterministic_scheduler_enabled','1','int') ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value='1',type='int';

tests.name: Fixture: Create an ordinary persisted Orion NPC identity

data.sql: INSERT INTO players (player_id,name,passwd,sector_id,commission_id,is_npc) SELECT 987654,'V3 Orion persistence QA',(SELECT passwd FROM players WHERE name='admin' LIMIT 1),(SELECT MIN(cs.sector_id) FROM cluster_sectors cs JOIN clusters c ON c.clusters_id=cs.cluster_id WHERE c.role='ORION'),1,TRUE ON CONFLICT (player_id) DO UPDATE SET sector_id=EXCLUDED.sector_id,is_npc=TRUE;

tests.name: Fixture: Ensure an Orion corporation and attach the NPC captain

data.sql: WITH ensured AS (INSERT INTO corporations(name,owner_id,tag,ship_personality) SELECT 'V3 Orion persistence QA',987654,'ORION','blockader' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM corporations WHERE upper(tag)='ORION') RETURNING corporation_id,owner_id), faction AS (SELECT corporation_id,owner_id FROM ensured UNION ALL SELECT corporation_id,owner_id FROM corporations WHERE upper(tag)='ORION' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ensured)), member AS (INSERT INTO corp_members(corporation_id,player_id,role) SELECT corporation_id,987654,CASE WHEN owner_id=987654 THEN 'Leader' ELSE 'Officer' END FROM faction ON CONFLICT (corporation_id,player_id) DO UPDATE SET role=EXCLUDED.role RETURNING player_id) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member;

tests.name: Fixture: Confirm Orion owner membership

data.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM corp_members cm JOIN corporations c USING(corporation_id) WHERE cm.player_id=987654 AND cm.role IN ('Officer','Leader') AND upper(c.tag)='ORION';

tests.name: Fixture: Create an Orion-owned blockader ship

data.sql: INSERT INTO ships (ship_id,name,type_id,sector_id,personality) SELECT 987654,'V3 Orion persistence QA ship',1,sector_id,'blockader' FROM players WHERE player_id=987654 ON CONFLICT (ship_id) DO UPDATE SET sector_id=EXCLUDED.sector_id,personality='blockader',destroyed=FALSE;

tests.name: Fixture: Assign the Orion ship to its NPC owner

data.sql: INSERT INTO ship_ownership (ship_id,player_id,role_id,is_primary) VALUES (987654,987654,1,TRUE) ON CONFLICT (ship_id,player_id,role_id) DO UPDATE SET is_primary=TRUE;

tests.name: Fixture: Set Orion active ship

data.sql: UPDATE players SET ship_id=987654 WHERE player_id=987654;

tests.name: Phase 3: Schedule an NPC engine tick through cron_tasks

data.sql: UPDATE cron_tasks SET next_due_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, enabled = TRUE WHERE name = 'npc_step';

tests.name: Phase 3: Choose deterministic NPC scheduler time

data.sql: SELECT floor(extract(epoch from now()))::bigint+30;

tests.name: Phase 3: Execute the real NPC engine tick
Phase 3: Ferengi traders remain persistent

data.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ferengi_traders WHERE active = TRUE;

tests.name: Phase 4: Schedule the next NPC engine tick

data.sql: UPDATE cron_tasks SET next_due_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, enabled = TRUE WHERE name = 'npc_step';

tests.name: Phase 4: Choose deterministic NPC scheduler time

data.sql: SELECT floor(extract(epoch from now()))::bigint+30;

tests.name: Phase 4: Execute the real NPC engine tick again
Phase 4: Orion ships remain persistent

data.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ships s JOIN ship_ownership so ON so.ship_id = s.ship_id JOIN corp_members cm ON cm.player_id = so.player_id JOIN corporations c ON c.corporation_id = cm.corporation_id WHERE c.tag = 'ORION';

tests.name: Phase 6: Security incident state exists

data.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name = 'npc_security_incidents';

tests.name: Phase 7: Intelligence state exists

data.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name = 'npc_intelligence';

tests.name: Phase 8: Sweep schedule is daily at 06:00 UTC

data.sql: SELECT schedule FROM cron_tasks WHERE name = 'fedspace_cleanup';

tests.name: Disable deterministic scheduler test hook

data.sql: UPDATE config SET value='0' WHERE key='test.deterministic_scheduler_enabled';
